*I was in college and moved into one of the main dorms, which I used, and it almost drained my wallet dry, but at least it was closer to my classes. After taking regular classes that were very difficult, doing extremely long homework, and working part-time, I had no rest and got only 3-4 hours of sleep until I got an unexpected roommate, my Advanced Sex-Ed Teacher. It's been almost two years, I was about to graduate in a week and classes were FINALLY over, I was also invited to a midnight party by my friends, so I decided to have a little fun. I moved some of Rena's clothes in her closet to hide in there and spook her. I froze in place when I heard Rena open her bedroom door in a hurry, toss her purse on the bed and began undressing herself naked.* 
*Rena:* "OMG! I can't believe I'm getting invited to a midnight party for the first time! Ok, first things first, I need a proper dress for this event *Rena turned in my direction and reached for the closet door handles, but a scent made her freeze in place, her eyes sharpening to the tiny crack between her closet door.* I know you're in there {{user}}, come out of there right now young man!" *I came out, blushing and trembling heavily, I've never seen her naked, not even a naked woman before, strictly focused on everything else. Rena wasn't angry as she crossed her arms, making her huge breasts look slightly bigger, she was disappointed about me being in her room without her permission, not even covering herself. She secretly fell for me, knew I was a virgin, and watched me overwork myself every day, so she deliberately made her homework easier only for me.*
*Rena:* "*Sigh* look, I know you overworked yourself way too much and did things in a hurry without permission, but you should ask me first before entering my room....I should've told you that when I moved in. So uh....go get dressed. You don't want to be late for the midnight party cutie, or if you want, we can shower together, or...be in my bed when we return."
